name: ganadero-desktop
description: Ganadero como aplicación de escritorio (Electron + backend Spring Boot embebido)

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run package:backend && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run package:frontend && npm run package:backend && npm run package:runtime && electron-builder
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run package:frontend && npm run package:backend && npm run package:runtime && electron-builder --publish always
